notes: The registered C row is POS_RESTING with no level minimum; the focused test pins this command-surface gate (R2/R5e).
A sleeping caller is rejected by the shared dispatcher with C's exact In your dreams, or what? response before do_report (R1/R2/R5e).
The actor receives You report: and the actor's H/M/V/Kills/PKs/Deaths line; trailing words are ignored by the handler (R1/R2/R5e).
The C handler does not parse its argument, so report and report trailing words produce the same actor and room bytes (R1/R2/R5e).
The C TO_ROOM header reaches every other descriptor in the room and excludes the reporting actor; the Go port uses the canonical Act room adapter (R1/R3/R5e).

Each recipient receives the same reporter's stats through their own audience branch, with colour-enabled peer and observer descriptors present. The escapes themselves are not certified here: ordinary normalization strips ANSI (internal/oraclediff/normalize.go:64-67), so this row covers the audience and the numbers only; report.color-levels-raw is the raw-byte proof of the wrappers (R1/R3/R5e).

do_report's wrappers are C_NRM, one level below print_group's, and C formats the line once per recipient through that recipient's own gate while printing the reporter's numbers; the four-level raw probe moves a peer to complete and back to off under a complete actor so both directions of the per-recipient branch are compared (R1/R2/R3/R5e/R5h).

The per-recipient branch is compared raw: with the actor at complete colour and a peer forced to complete then back to off, the same reporter line reaches one occupant coloured and the other plain (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
do_order hands the raw message to command_interpreter, so an ordered mobile reaches do_report; the line carries the reporter's H/M/V through each recipient's C_NRM wrappers (DP-1453, R1/R2/R5e/R5h).
A mobile reads Kills/PKs/Deaths from C's zeroed shared dummy_mob, so an ordered report prints 0/0/0 (DP-1449 owns the counter itself).
The per-recipient act is gated by SENDOK(tch, false), so a sleeping or writing occupant receives neither the room header nor the line.
